usage: GetOverallMetrics.py [-h] [--happy_vcf_fn HAPPY_VCF_FN]
                            [--log_happy LOG_HAPPY] [--ctgName CTGNAME]
                            [--output_fn OUTPUT_FN]

Overall Metrics of hap.py output

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --happy_vcf_fn HAPPY_VCF_FN
                        Path to the happy vcf output file
  --log_happy LOG_HAPPY
                        Path to the happy vcf output file
  --ctgName CTGNAME     The name of sequence to be processed
  --output_fn OUTPUT_FN
                        Filename of the metrics output
